name: Carlos Gomez
learned: Carlos Gomez is a poet who loves to explore his inner thoughts and feelings. He is always looking for new ways to express himself.
currently: Carlos Gomez is working on a collection of poetry that explores the beauty of the natural world. He is also attending creative writing workshops to hone his skills.
lifestyle: Carlos Gomez goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 7am, eats dinner around 5pm.
daily_req: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am
f_daily_schedule: Carlos is waking up and starting his morning routine (asleep)
Carlos is finishing his morning routine, having a light breakfast, and reviewing his poetry notes for today's creative writing workshop
Carlos is heading to the creative writing workshop, carrying his notebook and a draft of his latest nature poem
Carlos is participating in the creative writing workshop, sharing his latest nature poem with the group and receiving feedback
Carlos is continuing the creative writing workshop, now workshopping a peer's poem and jotting down notes on imagery and rhythm to apply to his own work
Carlos is wrapping up the creative writing workshop, packing his notebook, and heading out to grab a quick lunch before returning home to revise his poem based on the feedback he received
Carlos is returning home from lunch, settling into his study, and beginning to revise his nature poem, focusing on the imagery and rhythm feedback he received at the workshop
Carlos is deeply revising his nature poem, experimenting with new metaphors for the changing light, and then taking a short break to stretch and look out the window for inspiration
Carlos is returning to his desk after his short break, continuing to refine the metaphors in his nature poem, and then beginning to draft a second poem inspired by the workshop's discussion on rhythm
Carlos is finishing the first draft of his second poem, then stepping away from his desk to make a cup of tea and review his notes from the workshop before he starts preparing dinner
Carlos is preparing and eating his dinner, then cleaning up and settling in for a quiet evening of reading poetry before his 10pm bedtime
Carlos is settling into his reading chair with a collection of nature poetry, sipping his tea and marking passages that inspire his own work
Carlos is continuing to read his collection of nature poetry, now focusing on poems about dusk and twilight, and jotting down a few lines of his own in the margins for future revision

Carlos is continuing to read his nature poetry collection, now underlining a passage about the moonrise, and then closing the book to jot down a few new lines for a poem about the evening sky before he prepares for bed
Carlos is finishing his notes for the evening, turning off his reading lamp, and heading to the bathroom to brush his teeth and wash up before getting into bed for his 10pm sleep time
Carlos is getting into bed and turning off the lights, settling in for a full night of sleep to wake up refreshed at 7am
